nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $J$ be an ideal of $A$. If an invertible fractional ideal $I$ of $A$ in $K$ is prime to $J$, then its inverse $I^{-1}$ is prime to $J$.
nodes.title: Inverses of invertible fractional ideals prime to an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$. For every ideal $J$ of $A$, the unit fractional ideal $A$ of $A$ in $K$ is prime to $J$.
nodes.title: The unit fractional ideal is prime to every ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, let $I$ be a fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$ and let $J$ be an ideal of $A$. Then $I$ is prime to $J$ if for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ with $J \subseteq \mathfrak p$, the extension $I A_{\mathfrak p}$ of $I$ to the localization $A_{\mathfrak p}$, a fractional ideal of $A_{\mathfrak p}$ in $K$, is the unit fractional ideal $A_{\mathfrak p}$.
nodes.title: Fractional ideals prime to an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $J$ be an ideal of $A$. An invertible fractional ideal $I$ of $A$ in $K$ lies in the subgroup of invertible fractional ideals prime to $J$ if and only if $I$ is prime to $J$.
nodes.title: Membership in the subgroup of units prime to an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, let $I$ be a fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$ and let $J \subseteq J'$ be ideals of $A$. If $I$ is prime to $J$, then $I$ is prime to $J'$.
nodes.title: Prime to an ideal implies prime to every larger ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $J$ be an ideal of $A$. If fractional ideals $I$ and $I'$ of $A$ in $K$ are both prime to $J$, then their product $I I'$ is prime to $J$.
nodes.title: Products of fractional ideals prime to an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal of $A$. Every non-zero-divisor of $A$ maps to a non-zero-divisor of the localization $A_{\mathfrak p}$.
nodes.title: Non-zero-divisors stay non-zero-divisors in a localization at a prime

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $J \subseteq J'$ be ideals of $A$. Then the subgroup of invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$ prime to $J$ is contained in the subgroup of invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$ prime to $J'$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the subgroups of units prime to an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$. The subgroup of invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$ prime to the unit ideal $A$ is the whole group of invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$.
nodes.title: Every invertible fractional ideal is prime to the unit ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $J$ be an ideal of $A$. The invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$ that are prime to $J$ form a subgroup of the group of invertible fractional ideals of $A$ in $K$.
nodes.title: Invertible fractional ideals prime to an ideal

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
